notes: Melee 1v1 boxing with jab/hook/uppercut animations and a KO count is Action, not Sports: the Sports genre here is teams on a field with foul perimeters and scoring volumes, none of which a boxing ring has, and this genre's Fighting preset is modelled on exactly this kind of Roblox boxing game. The author's answers closed the two questions the prompt asked itself — one-on-one PvP, two players a server — so the map is a single flat ring canvas inside one bounded hall, which is space-bounded; the corners double as the anti-camp start points that spawn-protected places. I dropped the preset's cover-los and choke-bottleneck because pillars and funnels inside a boxing ring are the opposite of what was asked, and added spectator-zone for the requested stands and seating, which is what puts the build on tiered. Everything else in the prompt — gloves as Tools, health and stamina bars, the round timer, the leaderboard table, the play button — is scripting and UI under the author's own headings, so none of it reaches the layout.
